title: Expenses on a long trip
description: Log spending by country and currency, see the history and compare it with your own spending plan.

blocks.text: On a long trip, expenses pile up across different countries and currencies. What is needed is a clear diary you can keep continuously, rather than reassemble after getting home.

quote.text: We tried the free version of this app first as we set off to travel the world full time as retirees. Now we use the paid version and find it worth the small annual cost.

blocks.text: An entry keeps the original currency and amount; the conversion method chosen is shown separately. You can look at a period or a country, correct an entry and keep the history.
What decides whether it is useful

A scenario like this could be a mode inside an ordinary expense tracker. A separate product is worth testing on how easily countries and currencies change, on working without a connection and on keeping a long history, not on the number of ready-made reports.
